name: Garachico (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of black, white and turquoise.
history: The flag was approved by order of the Government of the Canary Islands of 15 October 1998 as a rectangular cloth whose length is one and a half times its width, composed of three horizontal stripes of equal size, the upper black, the central white and the lower turquoise blue; if the flag bears the arms they are placed at the centre at two thirds of the height, preferably on both sides. The municipality also has a standard, approved by order of 15 March 1994, a square turquoise flag with the arms at the centre.
